title: Sensor telemetry v1
description: Normative contract for telemetry from an NB-IoT sensor to Azure IoT Hub. See docs/mqtt-payload.md. Consumers ignore unknown fields, per ADR-004.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Incremented only for breaking changes.

messageId.description: Unique per message. Used for idempotency when a message is resent.

deviceId.description: INFORMATIONAL. The authoritative identity is the IoT Hub system property iothub-connection-device-id. A mismatch must be logged and the message rejected.

sentAt.description: Transmission time according to the device clock. ISO 8601 with UTC offset. May differ from IoT Hub enqueuedTime due to clock drift or buffered transmission.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per device. Gaps indicate lost messages.

measurements.description: One or more measurements. Multiple entries occur when a device transmits buffered readings after a network outage.

type.description: Measurement type. Only 'level' in v1. Extended additively.

value.description: Raw measured value. No conversion is performed on the device, per ADR-004.

measuredAt.description: Time of measurement. May lie far in the past for buffered transmissions and must not be rejected on that basis.

quality.description: The device's own assessment of the reading's reliability.

device.description: Only fields that are operationally necessary or required by the CRA. Static attributes (model, hardware revision, ICCID) belong in the IoT Hub device twin, per CRA Annex I Part I point (g).

firmware.description: REQUIRED. Running firmware version. Needed to identify vulnerable devices and to verify that security updates have been applied, per CRA Annex I Part II points 1, 2 and 7. Semantic versioning is recommended; the format is confirmed with the device vendor during hardware validation.

battery.description: Battery status. Operationally necessary for a large battery-powered fleet.

signal.description: NB-IoT radio diagnostics. Optional, included when the modem exposes the values. Without them, 'why did this device stop reporting' cannot be answered.

rsrp.description: Reference Signal Received Power, in dBm.

rsrq.description: Reference Signal Received Quality, in dB.
